population: DEVELOPMENT + SYNTHETIC -- nothing adjudicated, scored or persisted as an oracle artifact
contract: A40 F5 -- the realized controls through the real build_oracle path

tests.test: the committed manifest yields exactly 20 control stimuli, 8 / 8 / 4
tests.fails_when: the control population presented to the oracle is not the frozen 8/8/4 set

tests.test: every control renders and is blinded exactly once
tests.fails_when: a control failed to render, or two controls collapsed onto one identity or image

tests.test: the blind record carries EXACTLY the three permitted keys
tests.fails_when: the adjudicator-facing artifact carries a field that is not id/image/question

tests.test: every control takes BOTH result-bearing routes (A36.6)
tests.fails_when: a control class is missing from an answer route, so it cannot bound that route

tests.test: ONE stimulus, ONE image and ONE blind id serve both routes
tests.fails_when: a route-specific duplicate stimulus exists, which would double-count the control

tests.test: no control is a member of C, D, the C audit or R1
tests.fails_when: a control entered an estimand, so it would contribute to a denominator it must only bound

tests.test: the frame counts confirm the estimands saw nothing
tests.fails_when: controls leaked into a reported frame count
a private control value -- the expected heading above all -- reached the blind file

tests.test: the control join is complete against the committed manifest
tests.fails_when: a blind id is not bound to the image, region and private truth the key claims

tests.test: the four N-C controls render to FOUR DISTINCT images (F8)
tests.fails_when: two heading-free controls are the same picture, so they are one control presented twice

tests.test: NEGATIVE -- valid truth bound to the WRONG valid control is rejected
tests.fails_when: two controls can exchange their private truth undetected, so the key is decoration rather than a binding -- and nothing here is malformed, so it cannot fail for that reason

tests.test: ...and the shuffled records are still individually WELL-FORMED
tests.fails_when: the negative fails because a record is broken, which would prove nothing about binding
